lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized into approximately five vertical columns and four horizontal rows posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the central flank area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature running across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high luminance above and shadow below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Discrete high-luminance circular blobs are visible within the macro-mask of the partially visible first dorsal fin, showing a regular spatial distribution.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density cluster of significantly smaller, high-luminance punctate spots compared to the larger blobs on the primary flank; a small elongated dark object is visible ventrally.
